overview: This paper proposes DPad, a training-free inference strategy for diffusion-based large language models that uses a sliding window and distance-decay dropout to prune redundant suffix tokens, thereby reducing computational overhead while maintaining accuracy.

modules.name: Dataset and Prompt Loader
modules.description: Handles the loading and preprocessing of benchmarks, including the construction of few-shot prompts and the initialization of sequences with mask tokens required by diffusion models.

modules.name: Diffusion LLM Backbone Wrapper
modules.description: Encapsulates the loading and standard forward pass of diffusion language models, managing the bidirectional attention mechanism and the iterative unmasking logic based on confidence scores.

modules.name: DPad Suffix Sampling Engine
modules.description: Implements the core Gaussian-based distance-decay sampling algorithm to deterministically select a sparse subset of suffix tokens, implementing the sliding window and retention probability logic.

modules.name: Position Encoding Adjustment Handler
modules.description: Modifies the Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) logic to ensure positional consistency when processing non-contiguous, pruned suffix tokens during the attention calculation.

modules.name: DPad Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Orchestrates the main inference loop, integrating suffix sampling, model forward passes with pruned sequences, and implementing the early termination logic upon end-of-sequence detection.

modules.name: Baseline Optimizations Integration
modules.description: Implements or integrates existing acceleration baselines such as Parallel Decoding and Prefix Caching to enable comparative analysis and combined efficiency measurements.

modules.name: Efficiency and Latency Profiler
modules.description: Instruments the inference pipeline to measure end-to-end latency, tokens per second (TPS), active and peak GPU memory usage, and generation length metrics.

modules.name: Accuracy Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Calculates task-specific metrics including flexible and strict match for mathematical reasoning, and pass rates for code generation benchmarks.

modules.name: Scratchpad Mechanism Analyzer
modules.description: Provides tools to extract and visualize attention score maps (specifically Prefix/Current-to-Suffix blocks) and compute suffix token entropy to validate the Scratchpad hypothesis.

modules.name: Diffusion Lottery Ticket Validator
modules.description: Implements the experimental logic for the spike-shift analysis, forcibly pruning high-attention suffix tokens to observe attention redistribution and validate the Lottery Ticket hypothesis.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Configures and executes controlled experiments to analyze the impact of sliding window sizes, retention densities, and sampling functions (Uniform vs. Gaussian) on performance and efficiency.

modules.name: Experiment Manager and Reporter
modules.description: Handles configuration management, experiment logging, and the automated generation of result tables and performance comparison charts across different models and optimization strategies.
